name: Valk 5 M
description: Valk 5 M - The Valk 5 M is a fast, smooth magnetic 5x5 speed cube from QiYi, famous for setting the current 5x5 single and average world records. This puzzle features medium/strong magnets, primary internals, and fantastic stability and corner cutting. If you're serious about this event, the Valk 5 M is a must!
